title: Letter 34 — Lest You Perish Where You Hope to Be Saved
attribution_note: Letter 34 of 46 in the collection Letters Sent — see Letter 1 for provenance.

pairs.en: I. Let all present a petition to the pastor, that he remove the unfit abbess.
II. Keep more to your cell, and pray to God, and do whatever work you can.
III. Look not at what people do, but learn a pious life from books.
IV. Shut your ears and mouth and eyes, and open them only in church and in your cell alone.
V. Have friendship with no one, unless it be some pious friendship.
VI. Whatever is brought against you that is contrary, endure it all.
VII. If your mother seeks salvation, and not to please this world, then consider whether it is not better to go to your mother and live with her, when scandals appear in the monastery.

sections.heading: Guard yourself even in the monastery

pairs.en: You see, nowadays even monasteries have become worse than worldly houses. Guard yourself, lest you perish where you hope to be saved.
